cc:Work.dc:title: Cyberpunk 2077 frame rate at 2x
cc:Work.dc:description: AMD BC-250, 2560x1440, FSR 4 Performance, headless. SDR XeFG, Intel's shaders: 85.40 FPS; SDR FreeFG 1.0.0: 103.09 FPS; HDR10 XeFG, Intel's shaders: 84.16 FPS; HDR10 FreeFG 1.0.0: 101.28 FPS; SDR +20.7%; HDR10 +20.3%. Source: docs/data/cyberpunk-fps/data.json.
